grounding.reason: Suspected batch with no recorded variable and 6 replicates per group selects sva surrogate variables as design covariates (R-0068, R-0025); DESeq2 Wald with apeglm shrinkage and BH/independent filtering at alpha 0.05 (R-0001, R-0009, R-0010); the reference level is set explicitly to control per R-0036.

steps.description: Pre-filter to genes with at least 10 counts in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size). Set the condition factor reference level explicitly to control so a positive log2 fold change means higher in treated, and name the contrast as condition, treated (numerator), control (denominator). Estimate surrogate variables with sva on the normalized counts, with the full model ~condition and the null model ~1, letting the package estimate the number of surrogate variables; cap the number at a small value relative to 12 samples (at most 2-3) and state the number used and the reason. Correlate each surrogate variable with condition, with library size, and with the k=2 cluster assignment from T1S1, and report those correlations. Fit DESeq2 with design ~SV1 + ... + SVn + condition on the RAW counts — median-of-ratios size factors are estimated inside the model and the counts are never pre-adjusted. Run the Wald test, apply apeglm shrinkage to the condition coefficient, and use BH with independent filtering at alpha 0.05. Plot the unadjusted p-value histogram BEFORE reading the adjusted values; if it has a hill in the middle or rises toward one, re-estimate the null with fdrtool and report the estimated null proportion, and state that the BH values from that fit are not reliable. Export the full results table with unshrunken log2FoldChange, shrunken log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue and padj, plus MA and dispersion plots. caveats: Enrichment results depend on the method: report the method and present a set as a hypothesis for follow-up, not as a proven finding

GO BP is a nested hierarchy — parent and child hits are one finding, not many
steps.context: The reference store holds MSigDB human hallmark (2026.1), human GO BP/CC/MF (2026.1), human canonical pathways including KEGG MEDICUS/BioCarta/PID (2026.1), and WikiPathways human (2026.07.10). A Reactome-specific GMT is not catalogued in this environment; WikiPathways human and GO BP serve as the further collections after hallmark. If a collection is absent at run time, report which one and continue with those present — hallmark alone still answers the pathway question.
steps.question: Which coordinated pathway-level programmes distinguish treated from control kidney samples on the full ranked list of tested genes?

grounding.reason: Preranked fgsea on the full tested list is the default enrichment method (R-0107); human data takes hallmark first then further collections with releases stated (R-0048, R-0165); the disputed rank metric (R-0108) is resolved to the Wald statistic per R-0099. Reactome GMT is not catalogued here, so WikiPathways human and GO BP serve as the further collections.

constraints: Rank metric is the Wald statistic (stat) — the disputed choice is resolved in favour of stat because it scales the effect by its standard error and avoids the ties that a signed p-value produces and the low-count noise of an unshrunken fold change
Feed the full ranked list; never cut at padj or fold change before the test
Set size window 15 to 500, applied after intersecting each set with the tested genes
Test each collection separately with its own BH adjustment; do not merge collections
Use human collections only — this is a Homo sapiens kidney dataset; a mouse or rat GMT would silently return almost nothing
Set and record the random seed for the fgsea permutations
steps.description: Take the complete T1S2 DESeq2 results table — every tested gene, not a thresholded subset — and rank by the Wald statistic (the stat column). Apply a set size window of 15 to 500 genes computed after intersecting each set with the tested genes. Collapse redundant significant sets and report one representative per overlap group, keeping the full table as a supplement. Report per collection: its release/version, the number of sets tested, the number significant at padj < 0.05, and the leading-edge genes of each significant set with their gene-level statistics, marking leading-edge overlap between reported sets. Gene identifiers in counts.csv are HGNC symbols and the staged collections use symbols, so no identifier conversion is required; if any mapping is nonetheless performed, report the unmapped share. Hallmark results reported, plus at least one further human collection (WikiPathways human and/or GO BP), each tested and adjusted separately
Each collection reported with its release, number of sets tested after the 15-500 size window, and number significant at padj < 0.05
Leading-edge genes listed per significant set, with overlap between reported sets marked
Redundant significant sets collapsed to representatives, with the full table retained as a supplement

caveats: Removing a sample changes the dispersion estimates and the gene list; a reader shown one fit cannot judge that dependence
Surrogate variables adjust for structure whose biological identity remains unknown — the report should say what was adjusted for and what was not learned
steps.context: The research question asks which genes differ between treated and control. The honest answer is conditional on what T1S1 found about the two clusters, and the report must make that conditionality the first thing the reader sees.
steps.question: What is the defensible answer to 'which genes differ between treated and control', given the unexplained two-cluster structure in these 12 kidney samples?

grounding.reason: Report contents follow the reporting rules returned by the procedure: method/versions/design/thresholds (R-0041), shrunken and unshrunken effects (R-0085), MA and dispersion diagnostics (R-0087), both fits if a sample was removed (R-0090), two-method overlap (R-0042), enrichment reporting and its method-dependence (R-0051, R-0055, R-0105), and the reproducibility record (R-0086).

constraints: Do not present the union of DESeq2 and edgeR calls as the result
Do not report BH-adjusted p-values as the headline result if the p-value histogram was irregular after the SVA fit — state the shape and the fdrtool null estimate instead
State plainly that with 6 vs 6 samples and an unexplained dominant axis of variance the analysis is modestly powered and the gene list is provisional
No claim of a treatment mechanism beyond what the contrast and the enrichment support
steps.description: Assemble one report from T1S1, T1S2, T1S2b and T2S1. Lead with the structural finding: the two six-sample clusters, their cross-tabulation against condition, and whether the hidden factor was adjustable or confounded — this determines what the gene list means and must not be relegated to a footnote. Then state the method, package versions, the design formula including the number of surrogate variables, the reference level and contrast direction, the thresholds, the number of genes tested after filtering, and the number of differentially expressed genes. Present the gene table with unshrunken log2FoldChange, apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE, ranked by the shrunken value, with p-values from the unshrunken fit. Include the MA plot, the dispersion plot and the p-value histogram with its shape described. Report the DESeq2/edgeR overlap as the high-confidence set with the method-specific genes named separately. Report the enrichment per collection with its release, the rank metric, the universe, the size window and the leading edge, and state that enrichment results are method-dependent. If any sample was excluded, give the pre-specified numeric criterion, name the sample, and report both fits with the number of significant genes from each, the intersection, and the genes that change status; name the criterion-supported fit as primary and the other as the sensitivity run. Gene table carries unshrunken log2FoldChange, shrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE, ranked by the shrunken value
MA plot, dispersion plot and p-value histogram included, with the histogram shape described in words
DESeq2/edgeR overlap reported with the intersection named as the high-confidence set
Enrichment reported per collection with release, rank metric, universe, size window and leading-edge genes, plus the method-dependence caveat
Reproducibility record present: sessionInfo, seeds, package versions, collection versions
If a sample was excluded, both fits are reported with the criterion stated and the primary fit named

plan.title: Treated vs control kidney RNA-seq with SVA batch adjustment
plan.analytical_narrative:
The inputs are a 12,000 x 12 raw Salmon gene-level count matrix (counts.csv, gene symbols in the first column) and a 12-row sample table (metadata.csv) with one condition column: 6 treated vs 6 control, unpaired, human kidney. The profile flags the central problem: the PCA separates the samples into two clusters of six that do NOT follow the condition, and no processing batch is recorded. That structure is the dominant axis of variance and, if left out of the model, it inflates the test statistics and produces a confident but unsupported gene list.

The plan therefore does three things in order. T1S1 characterises the structure before any test: blind VST, PCA on the top 500 variable genes, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes and detected-gene counts, and an explicit cross-tabulation of the two six-sample clusters against condition and against every technical proxy available in the count matrix itself (library size, detection rate, and the gene-symbol composition of the top-expressed genes). The critical determination it must make is whether the hidden factor is balanced across condition (3 treated + 3 control per cluster, in which case it is adjustable) or confounded with it (in which case no model separates the two and the analysis must stop at descriptive). T1S2 then fits the model the situation calls for: because a batch is suspected, no recorded variable explains it, and each group has 6 replicates, surrogate variables are estimated with sva using condition as the known factor and added to the DESeq2 design as covariates beside condition. The counts themselves are never adjusted before the test — an adjusted-count test reports confidence the data does not support. T1S2b runs edgeR quasi-likelihood with robust dispersion on the same design as an independent second method, and the intersection is the high-confidence gene set. T2S1 takes the full ranked list of tested genes by the DESeq2 Wald statistic into fgsea against the human hallmark sets, then human WikiPathways and human GO BP as further collections, each reported with its own release and never merged. T1S3 consolidates.

Two honesty constraints are built in rather than bolted on. First, if the two clusters turn out to be confounded with treated/control, the differential expression result cannot be attributed to treatment and the report must say so as its headline, not as a footnote. Second, with a suspected batch a clean p-value histogram is not evidence of a clean fit; the histogram must be inspected after the SVA fit and, if irregular, fdrtool re-estimates the null and the BH values are not reported as the result. No sample is removed silently: any exclusion needs a stated numeric technical criterion fixed before the test, and both fits are reported.

steps.method: Sample structure QC: blind VST, PCA on top 500 variable genes, sample distance heatmap, library sizes, cluster-vs-condition cross-tab
Keep genes with at least 10 counts in at least 6 samples
Surrogate variable analysis (sva) with surrogate variables as design covariates: ~ SV1 + ... + SVn + condition
DESeq2 Wald test on the SVA-extended design
apeglm log fold change shrinkage on the condition coefficient
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR with independent filtering, p-value histogram inspected, fdrtool empirical null if irregular
edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test with robust dispersion on the same SVA design (robustness second method)
fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome-equivalent second collection and WikiPathways human
Consolidated report: design, SV count, both fits, overlap of DESeq2 and edgeR, MA and dispersion plots, leading edge genes, sessionInfo

parameters.value: method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, n_de, session_info

steps.name: Preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic
steps.question: Which coordinated pathway-level programmes distinguish treated from control kidney samples on the full ranked list of tested genes?
steps.description: Take the complete T1S2 DESeq2 results table — every tested gene, not a thresholded subset — and rank by the Wald statistic (the stat column). Run fgsea against, in order: the human hallmark gene set collection; the human WikiPathways collection; and the human GO biological process collection, each as a separate test with its own BH adjustment, never merged into one set list. Apply a set size window of 15 to 500 genes computed after intersecting each set with the tested genes. Collapse redundant significant sets and report one representative per overlap group, keeping the full table as a supplement. Report per collection: its release/version, the number of sets tested, the number significant at padj < 0.05, and the leading-edge genes of each significant set with their gene-level statistics, marking leading-edge overlap between reported sets. Gene identifiers in counts.csv are HGNC symbols and the staged collections use symbols, so no identifier conversion is required; if any mapping is nonetheless performed, report the unmapped share. If the significant gene list from T1S2 is smaller than about 50 genes, do not fall back to an over-representation test — the ranked method on the full list is the correct choice and the size of the significant list should be stated.
steps.context: The reference store holds MSigDB human hallmark (2026.1), human GO BP/CC/MF (2026.1), human canonical pathways including KEGG MEDICUS/BioCarta/PID (2026.1), and WikiPathways human (2026.07.10). A Reactome-specific GMT is not catalogued in this environment; WikiPathways human and GO BP serve as the further collections after hallmark. If a collection is absent at run time, report which one and continue with those present — hallmark alone still answers the pathway question.
acceptance_criteria: fgsea run on the full ranked list of all tested genes, ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic, with the metric stated
Hallmark results reported, plus at least one further human collection (WikiPathways human and/or GO BP), each tested and adjusted separately
Each collection reported with its release, number of sets tested after the 15-500 size window, and number significant at padj < 0.05
Leading-edge genes listed per significant set, with overlap between reported sets marked
Redundant significant sets collapsed to representatives, with the full table retained as a supplement
constraints: Rank metric is the Wald statistic (stat) — the disputed choice is resolved in favour of stat because it scales the effect by its standard error and avoids the ties that a signed p-value produces and the low-count noise of an unshrunken fold change
Feed the full ranked list; never cut at padj or fold change before the test
Set size window 15 to 500, applied after intersecting each set with the tested genes
Test each collection separately with its own BH adjustment; do not merge collections
Use human collections only — this is a Homo sapiens kidney dataset; a mouse or rat GMT would silently return almost nothing
Set and record the random seed for the fgsea permutations
caveats: Enrichment results depend on the method: report the method and present a set as a hypothesis for follow-up, not as a proven finding
If the T1S2 fit was labelled descriptive_only because the hidden factor is confounded with condition, the enrichment inherits that limitation and must be reported as descriptive
GO BP is a nested hierarchy — parent and child hits are one finding, not many

steps.name: Consolidated report with structure caveat
steps.question: What is the defensible answer to 'which genes differ between treated and control', given the unexplained two-cluster structure in these 12 kidney samples?
steps.description: Assemble one report from T1S1, T1S2, T1S2b and T2S1. Lead with the structural finding: the two six-sample clusters, their cross-tabulation against condition, and whether the hidden factor was adjustable or confounded — this determines what the gene list means and must not be relegated to a footnote. Then state the method, package versions, the design formula including the number of surrogate variables, the reference level and contrast direction, the thresholds, the number of genes tested after filtering, and the number of differentially expressed genes. Present the gene table with unshrunken log2FoldChange, apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE, ranked by the shrunken value, with p-values from the unshrunken fit. Include the MA plot, the dispersion plot and the p-value histogram with its shape described. Report the DESeq2/edgeR overlap as the high-confidence set with the method-specific genes named separately. Report the enrichment per collection with its release, the rank metric, the universe, the size window and the leading edge, and state that enrichment results are method-dependent. If any sample was excluded, give the pre-specified numeric criterion, name the sample, and report both fits with the number of significant genes from each, the intersection, and the genes that change status; name the criterion-supported fit as primary and the other as the sensitivity run. Close with the reproducibility record: sessionInfo, seeds, package versions and the version of each gene set collection used.
steps.context: The research question asks which genes differ between treated and control. The honest answer is conditional on what T1S1 found about the two clusters, and the report must make that conditionality the first thing the reader sees.

Method, package versions, design formula with SV count, reference level, contrast direction, thresholds, n tested and n DE are all stated

MA plot, dispersion plot and p-value histogram included, with the histogram shape described in words
DESeq2/edgeR overlap reported with the intersection named as the high-confidence set
Enrichment reported per collection with release, rank metric, universe, size window and leading-edge genes, plus the method-dependence caveat
Reproducibility record present: sessionInfo, seeds, package versions, collection versions
If a sample was excluded, both fits are reported with the criterion stated and the primary fit named
constraints: Do not present the union of DESeq2 and edgeR calls as the result
Do not report BH-adjusted p-values as the headline result if the p-value histogram was irregular after the SVA fit — state the shape and the fdrtool null estimate instead
